final: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS share FROM account_orders), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.share) AS average_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share
